How Can We Help You?

Everything you need to pair an old tablet, configure caregiver alerts, and protect your family.

3-Minute Living Room Setup

Zero App Installation
01

Find a Spare Phone or Tablet

Any Android (v8+) or iPad device connected to home Wi-Fi and kept on the tabletop plugged into power works perfectly.

02

Open Tabletop Mode in Browser

Navigate to Kavach Tabletop mode. Enter the 6-digit family pairing code from your Guardian app to sync alerts.

03

Instruct Elder to Answer on Speaker

Whenever an unfamiliar number, robocall, or video caller rings, simply press the phone’s Speakerphone button so both parties can hear.

Frequently Asked Questions

Have a Specific Household Setup Question?

Our engineering team responds to caregiver inquiries within 4 business hours.

Contact Caregiver Support
Kavach

Kavach listens on a dedicated second device when you take a call on speaker. We do not tap, record, or intercept telco lines.
